groups.name: Fully rounded pill buttons
groups.definition: Are the primary buttons or calls to action fully rounded pills?

groups.name: Square or small-radius buttons
groups.definition: Do buttons have square corners or only a small corner radius rather than pill shapes?

groups.name: Solid filled brand-color CTA buttons
groups.definition: Are the main call-to-action buttons solid filled with a brand color and rounded or plain corners?

groups.name: Primary plus outlined secondary buttons
groups.definition: Does a primary solid button appear alongside an outlined secondary button?

groups.name: Secondary CTAs as text links
groups.definition: Are secondary or read-more actions styled as text links rather than boxed buttons?

groups.name: Social links as text labels
groups.definition: Are social links plain text labels (possibly pills) rather than icon glyphs?

groups.name: Circular social icons
groups.definition: Are social links shown as small circular icon or letter badges?

groups.name: Pill chips and tags
groups.definition: Are tags, filters, or suggested links shown as small rounded pill chips?

groups.name: Small badges and labels
groups.definition: Are categories, dates, or status shown as small badge or label boxes?

groups.name: Circular pagination controls
groups.definition: Does pagination or carousel navigation use circular dots or rounded boxes?

groups.name: Search field joined with button
groups.definition: Is search an input joined to a labeled button, or absent from the header?

groups.name: Inline newsletter signup
groups.definition: Is the newsletter signup an email input inline with a submit button?

groups.name: Simple form layout
groups.definition: Do forms use simple narrow or full-width native controls?

groups.name: Segmented toggle control
groups.definition: Is there a segmented toggle for binary or purchase choices?

groups.name: Top announcement strip
groups.definition: Is there a thin announcement strip at the top of the page?

groups.name: Full-width promo or CTA band
groups.definition: Is there a full-width solid or dark promotional band with a headline and CTA?

groups.name: Dark utility bar above header
groups.definition: Is there a slim dark utility bar above the main header?

groups.name: Horizontal text navigation
groups.definition: Is navigation a visible horizontal row of text links?

groups.name: Menu toggle button
groups.definition: Is there a rounded text menu toggle button?

groups.name: Plain text logo wordmark
groups.definition: Is the logo a text wordmark with a small accent rather than an image?

groups.name: Dark footer
groups.definition: Is the footer a dark band?

groups.name: Light footer with simple links
groups.definition: Is the footer light with plain link columns or rows?

groups.name: Plain link lists
groups.definition: Are link lists plain single-column stacks of bold links?

groups.name: Underlined inline links
groups.definition: Are inline body links underlined?

groups.name: Bold links without underline
groups.definition: Are links bold and not underlined?

groups.name: Bordered rounded content cards
groups.definition: Are content items shown as bordered or rounded white cards in a grid?

groups.name: Text-only cards with accent edge
groups.definition: Are cards text-only with a colored left or top accent border?

groups.name: Text overlaid on imagery
groups.definition: Is text overlaid on images or thumbnails?

groups.name: Statistics display
groups.definition: Are statistics shown as numbers in tiles or inline?

groups.name: Section header with view-all link
groups.definition: Do section headers pair a heading with a right-aligned view-all link?

groups.name: Heading with accent underline rule
groups.definition: Do section headings have a short accent underline rule?

groups.name: Logo strips and sponsor grids
groups.definition: Are logos displayed in white tiles, strips, or grids?

groups.name: Medium corner radius scale
groups.definition: Do cards and buttons consistently use 8-15px radii?

groups.name: Profile and avatar elements
groups.definition: Are people shown as profile cards, avatars, or testimonial photos?

groups.name: Miscellaneous content blocks
groups.definition: Does the page include a distinct content block such as a calendar, feed, share links, or sign-up block?
